## Overview

This directory contains technology patterns for autonomous AI application development pipelines. These patterns define the orchestration layer that coordinates the Golden Path catalog, AI generation agents, four-layer verification infrastructure, and deployment automation into end-to-end autonomous development workflows.

These patterns represent Phase 3 capabilities in the [Enterprise Golden Path Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/enterprise-golden-path-strategy.md) and are explicitly dependent on Phases 1 and 2 being complete before deployment.
page_texts.3:
[patterns/technology/ai-development/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Enable autonomous AI development workflows that:

- Accept structured human-authored intent documents as the sole human input
- Automatically select applicable Golden Paths and parameterize them for the stated intent
- Generate complete application and infrastructure stacks using AI agents
- Apply all four verification layers automatically before any deployment occurs
- Activate runtime monitoring as part of the deployment step

## Implementation Phasing

These patterns require Phase 2 of the [Enterprise Golden Path Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/enterprise-golden-path-strategy.md) to be complete before deployment:

| Phase | Patterns Required | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Phase 3 — Autonomous Development | PTN-TEC-AI-001 | Months 13–24 |

> **Critical prerequisite**: This pattern requires all 8 dependent patterns (governance/ai-development × 5, infrastructure/governance × 2, application/governance × 2) to be operational. See the Dependencies section in [PTN-TEC-AI-001](./PTN-TEC-AI-001-intent-to-infrastructure-pipeline-pattern.md) for the complete list.

## Pipeline Architecture

The Intent-to-Infrastructure Pipeline orchestrates all 10 other AI development governance patterns:

```
Human Input: Structured Intent Document PR
        │
        ▼
Stage 1: Intent Parser + Golden Path Selector
         └── Consumes: PTN-GOV-AI-001 (Catalog)
        │
        ▼
Stage 2: AI Generation Agent
         └── Consumes: PTN-APP-GOV-002 (Context Integration)
         └── Tags:     PTN-GOV-AI-005 (AI Provenance)
        │
        ▼
Stage 3: Four-Layer Verification
         L1: PTN-INFRA-GOV-001 (Conformance Gate)
         L2: PTN-APP-GOV-001   (Fitness Functions)
         L3: PTN-INFRA-GOV-002 (Policy-as-Code)
         All → PTN-GOV-AI-004  (Evidence Store)
        │
        ▼
Stage 4: Semantic Validation
        │
        ▼
Stage 5: Deployment Gate → Activates PTN-APP-GOV-003 (Runtime Monitors)
```
